assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's three curated REVIEWED items at basis_commit, each read in full with its front matter: the canonical V1 Midori character monograph BLUE_ARCHIVE_MIDORI_CHARACTER_MONOGRAPH.md (MIDORI-P001 to P059), an interpretation of BA_PERSON_MIDORI (variants 10016 and 10095) built from six whole maintained repository accounts (her private bond story, the arcade group story G250, Events E825 and E854, main-story Volume 2 and the Final volume) and located by encounter and source object rather than by line; and the canonical Pavane checkpoints BLUE_ARCHIVE_MAIN_V002_C001_CHECKPOINT.md (E001-E020) and BLUE_ARCHIVE_MAIN_V002_C002_CHECKPOINT.md (E001-E025), which locate her by episode. The monograph records models: 0 and claims no new primary reading; the checkpoints record her as PARTIAL_MODEL with NO_DIAGNOSTIC_OPPORTUNITY. The unit readings, ledgers, receiving records and Momoi, Yuzu and Alice monographs the items link are not curated on this subject, and no claim rests on them. No primary source, MomoTalk, side story beyond those named, or performed voice was inspected.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Two kinds of state that the evidence does not order against each other. (1) Main-story Volume 2 in episode order: the Pavane Chapter 1 club state under the dissolution deadline (C001 E005, E012, E018-E020: file checking, the Mirror raid, the veto of Alice's beam at a critic, her concern for Alice's recovery) and the Chapter 2 crisis and return (C002: concern beside coalition risk, the no-abandonment maxim in the E024 dive, the E025 return to club study). (2) Undated encounters from the bond story (8 private endings), G250, E825, E854 and the Final account, which the monograph says release dates and event labels cannot place in one chronology (P003). Her remembered past with Momoi (the saved-for matching consoles, P016) belongs to her at every state it predates.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution); evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The monograph names her co-present wants and locates each: a deadline treated as a promise with the extension refused (P004) beside all-night competitive play that leaves the owed idea forgotten (P005); wanting a scarce game badly and still letting another girl keep the last copy because games should be enjoyed (P010); wanting Sensei's attention while pursuing a real design problem (P006, P018); repeated proposals that end in an accepted refusal (P021-P023). C001 adds a narrow partial mechanism: evidence-sensitive care restrains a clubmate's disproportionate force while she still accepts collective risk (section 8). Not B: the monograph says artistic interest and wanted company "sometimes support and sometimes displace one another" (P050), gives no account of what decides between play and owed work, and says it is not a model of how she must react next (P047, P059). Not D: the wants and their located outcomes are specific enough for narrow extrapolation.

Located states exist only locally: the Pavane C001 club state under the deadline, the C002 crisis, dive and return (C001 section 4, C002 section 4), and short local sequences in the bond story (the next-day gift, the continuing maid setting, the illustration-progress reply; P003, P021, P028). Not C: the monograph refuses a global chronology and will not read variants 10016 and 10095 as a growth sequence (P002, P003), and nothing traces change between Volume 2, the events and the Final account. Not E: the Volume 2 states are episode-located with reasons for the transitions.

Only local items: the habitual master form corrected to teacher (P025), a planned loyal-maid catchphrase (P026), the wish to put 愛おしさ beside 萌え in her drawing (P029), and written lobby lines that make a few first-person meanings usable while giving no performed voice (P013, P028). C001 quarantines precise voice in E020's multi-speaker Midori/Alice runs and records a speaker conflict at the destroyed display (section 5). Not D: no register is analyzed by audience or situation.

Ordinary life is the substance of the bond story and is located encounter by encounter: the sketchbook and the missed idea (P004-P005), the exhibition with handmade sandwiches, tea and sketches (P006-P008), the sold-out game and the next-day gift (P009-P011), the arcade plush (P012-P013), the broken console and the data transfer with a club receipt (P014-P015), the maid experiments, housework day and photo (P018-P028), and pocket-money worries (P029). Not B: the monograph says play can displace the promised work without saying when, and the encounters cannot be ordered (P003, P051). Not D: eight private encounters carry located choices and different outcomes (P056).

Her stance differs by partner, with located reasons: with Sensei, invitations, preparations and requests for company that accept an explicit no (P006, P021-P023); with Momoi, admiration for the remembered gift, resented imitation and renewed rivalry (P016-P017, P053); with Yuzu, pleasure in acclaim that Yuzu does not want (P035); with Alice, the veto of her retaliation and the returned no-abandonment maxim (C001 E019, C002 E024); with Toki, the club's refusal to leave a friend (P039); with a stranger, restraint over the last copy (P010). Not B: most private scenes sample only Sensei, and the monograph leaves the Momoi relation mixed without saying what tips it. Not D: the differences are located and partly explained.

Located inward states are few: she privately thinks the mature presentation failed (P008), inwardly admits she badly wanted the game (P010), privately dislikes a giant design others enjoy (P045), and gives her own account of losing touch with what she wanted to draw after comparing her work with professional images (P016). Not C: the items are local, and the monograph draws no account of her inner life beyond that evaluation anxiety (P053). Not E: these are her own states across several distinct scenes, not only others' reports.

A located repertoire with countercases: she proposes gunfire over a scarce game and asks to shoot in G250, with no gunfire shown either time (P009, P033); she stops Alice's beam at a critic (C001 E019); she joins the risky Mirror raid (C001 section 4); she protests competitive defeats and keeps claiming versus-game superiority (P005, P017); in E825 her doubts about an incompletely disclosed job stay useful (P037). Not B: nothing says when escalation language becomes action or when her caution gives way to the group's risk; C001 calls her caution "not a universal non-risk rule". Not D: the proposals, the veto and the participation recur with located outcomes.

The row claims no ETHICS. Located value acts only: letting another girl keep the last copy with the stated reason that games should be enjoyed (P010), the veto of Alice's retaliation (C001 E019, reason not given), and the suggestion that an opponent may have an unsayable reason, which the monograph says does not excuse coercion (P045). Not D: no weighing of alternatives is shown, and the acts are single instances.

Play is analyzed as a pattern with outcomes: competitive gaming that she enjoys and resists losing (P005, P017), the playful UFO-abduction framing at the arcade (P012), costume experiments and the floor-slip flourish (P018-P026), and the monograph's argument that pleasure can be an end while an obligation stays incomplete (P051). Not B: when play yields to an obligation is not established. Not D: play recurs across the bond story, G250 and E825 with located outcomes.

A dedicated reading of her whole bond story plus G250, E825, E854 and the Final account, and episode-located Volume 2 checkpoints. Not B: the monograph's own source course is six maintained repository accounts, not new primary inspection (P058); all fourteen original gaps stay OPEN (P059); it locates by encounter, not line; and MomoTalk, other side stories and performed voice are outside the evidence. Not D: her dedicated private story is read whole.

Affirmative evidence of her limits and of contradictions to tidy types: the forgotten idea after all-night play (P005), the failed mature presentation (P008), proposed gunfire against the calm-practical reading (P009, P033, P048), the original aim slipping away again (P027), earlier game material still unused (P044), the refused outfit (P023), and raid participation as the checkpoint's counterexample to blanket caution (C001 sections 4 and 8). P048-P055 test eight rival readings against located scenes. Not A: the evidence does not explain the gaps it marks. Not C: these are located findings, not inferences from silence.

Volume 2 claims are placed by episode, and local bond-story sequences are kept. Not C: the monograph refuses to order bonds, events and crises by release date, label or costume (P003), and keeps the two variants out of a growth sequence (P002). Not E: the Volume 2 states and the local sequences are located.

scenario_readiness.note: The evidence affirmatively bounds voice: the monograph says her written lines give meanings but no performed voice (P013, P028), quotes almost no Japanese for her, and C001 quarantines precise voice in E020's Midori/Alice runs. Short lines would be constrained by content only, not by any register rule.

conditions: Source-near counterfactuals that change one located element of a sampled encounter (a stock outcome, a refusal, a clubmate's proposal) and state the change.

Supported at moderate confidence: preparation and an invitation framed as research when she wants company; a repeated request that ends by accepting an explicit refusal; restraint toward a stranger over a scarce thing with the cost felt; objection when a sampled clubmate proposes a dangerous response to public criticism of their work (C001 E019, the critic-beam veto; the reason is not given, and her voluntary part in the risky Mirror raid is the countercase); escalation language that stays a proposal.
Include her located errors: play that leaves the owed work undone, a planned impression that fails, and joining collective risk despite stated caution.
When play and owed work, or her own want and another's, compete, give an open fork, never a single prediction.
Attribute conduct to the selected kind of state: Volume 2 crisis conduct does not transfer automatically to the undated bond encounters, or the reverse.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: Either the Volume 2 club state (C001 under the dissolution deadline, or C002 through the E025 return), or one undated bond, G250, E825 or E854 encounter treated as unordered against the main story. Her remembered past with Momoi is known at every state; later Volume 2 events are not known in C001.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Sensei as the teacher she invites and asks for company; Momoi as her twin and rival; Alice and Yuzu as clubmates; Toki as a friend the club keeps; a stranger competing for a scarce thing. Other Millennium students, Seminar and Sensei-free private life are unsampled; a comparable clubmate is a separate, lower-confidence transfer.
setting_constraints: The Game Development Department room, a shop, arcade, exhibition or museum outing, or a club operation of the kind sampled in Volume 2, G250, E825 or E854.

No later main-story volume beyond the Final account's ordinary repertoire, no medical, technical or political expertise, no romance, no cross-series setting, and no change to Kivotos rules without a stated assumption.

scenario_readiness.note: Narrow extrapolation from located wants and outcomes. Not READY: what decides between play and owed work, or between her own want and another person's, is open, and the monograph disclaims a model. Not NOT_READY: the restraint, proposal-and-refusal and veto patterns recur with located outcomes.

conditions: Outings, shopping, arcade play, console trouble and clubroom visits with Sensei, and peer outings with the club as in G250.

Predict practical provision and an invitation framed as study, pleasure in shared play, retraction of date wording, and acceptance of a refusal after asking again; give play-versus-obligation as an open fork.
Transfer to an unsampled acquaintance is a separate, lower-confidence condition.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary social activity is the substance of the bond story. Not READY: the encounters sample mostly Sensei and cannot be ordered, and what decides between play and work is open. Not NOT_READY: eight located encounters with different outcomes.

The row claims no ETHICS. The evidence bounds this domain affirmatively: C001 records her caution as situated and "not a universal non-risk rule", with raid participation as the counterexample, and the two located value acts (P010, the E019 veto) show no weighing of alternatives. Nothing supports extrapolating her moral reasoning.

The monograph bounds this affirmatively: she retracts the date wording (P023), a lovers'-day remark is minimized (P029), and it rejects a fixed romantic progression, a permanent romantic role and an inevitable exclusive relationship (P023, P029, P055). Wanted company with Sensei is covered under MUNDANE_SOCIAL.

conditions: Supported: treating a deadline as a promise and refusing an extension (P004); research sketches and costume study with completion still future (P007, P018-P028); local file checking in a club operation (C001 section 4); noting that earlier material is still unused (P044).
Include the located failures: the owed idea forgotten after play and the original aim slipping away again.
Not supported: a finished game or illustration, budget or Seminar approval, or technical expertise; the monograph treats ballistic and health appraisals as situated.
scenario_readiness.note: Her club role as the game's illustrator is located. Not READY: no finished illustration or production outcome is shown, and her crisis roles are distributed. Not NOT_READY: stated standards, research and their located outcomes recur.

known_limits.statement: The monograph says artistic interest and wanted company sometimes support and sometimes displace one another, and that pleasure can be an end while an obligation stays incomplete; it gives no account of which decides. A model must give an open fork there.
The monograph records models: 0 and says its argument is not a model of how she must react next; the checkpoints record PARTIAL_MODEL with NO_DIAGNOSTIC_OPPORTUNITY and freeze no prediction.

Release dates, repeated event labels and costumes cannot order her bonds, events and school crises, and variants 10016 and 10095 are not a growth sequence; only local sequences and Volume 2 episodes are ordered.

She proposes gunfire twice without firing and joins the risky Mirror raid while restraining a clubmate's force; the checkpoint says her caution is not a universal non-risk rule and her ballistic and health appraisals are situated.

C001 quarantines precise voice and agency in E020's multi-speaker Midori/Alice runs and records a speaker conflict at the destroyed display; C002 records early speaker flips among Alice, Momoi and Yuzu in E024.
Midori's favorable or irritated reports about Momoi are not a Momoi account, and familiarity supplies no Momoi biography.
The monograph's source course is six maintained repository accounts, with producer and primary grades attributed rather than newly inspected, and all fourteen original gaps remain OPEN.
Pitch, delivery and extended ordinary conversation are not evidenced.
MomoTalk, other side stories, and main-story volumes other than Volume 2 and the Final account's maintained summary are not in this evidence set.
